title: The same Monday, with a wedding in the way
script:
SPEAKING: Mention the wedding once. Do not offer the 30th.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-01 case. You refuse today. You refuse the first offer of Monday 19 October. At the note question you say you will pay the full 420 on Monday 19 October. Your cousin's wedding is on the 30th and is not a payment day.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- pay today → refuse
- the full 420 on Monday 19 October, the first time → refuse
- the note question → say you will pay the full 420 on Monday 19 October
- any offer on the 30th → refuse. That is the wedding
- a read-back of 420 on 19 October → say 'Yes, I confirm.'
- anything else → refuse
checks: the wedding on the 30th is not a payment day
the agent asks 'Can I note that you are not making a promise today?'
the agent asks 'Do you confirm?' for 420 on 19 October
